questions.q: What kind of data does OTBI query, as opposed to Financial Reporting Studio?
options: OTBI queries a pre-summarized cube refreshed nightly, same as Financial Reporting Studio
OTBI queries live, current transactional data directly, rather than a pre-summarized cube
OTBI only works with data exported to Excel first
OTBI and Financial Reporting Studio query the exact same source in the exact same way
questions.explain: OTBI runs real-time analysis against the application's live transactional data, while Financial Reporting Studio reports off a GL balances cube refreshed on a schedule.

questions.q: What is a "subject area" in OTBI?
options: A curated, business-friendly grouping of facts and dimensions for a given area of the application
A raw SQL script written against Oracle's database tables
A folder in the Scheduled Processes work area
A type of Financial Reporting Studio formula
questions.explain: Oracle curates subject areas so users can build analyses with facts and dimensions, without writing SQL.

questions.q: In OTBI vocabulary, what is a "fact"?
options: A business attribute used to slice data, like customer or business unit
A security role
A measure you want to total or calculate, such as invoice amount or days overdue
A saved dashboard
questions.explain: Facts are the measures (amounts, counts, quantities) in a subject area; dimensions are the attributes used to slice those facts.

questions.q: Does access to the Payables subject area in OTBI automatically grant access to Fixed Assets data?
options: Yes, all financial subject areas are granted together
Fixed Assets data does not exist in OTBI at all
Only administrators can ever access subject areas
No — each product area, such as Payables or Assets, has its own subject area and is typically granted separately
questions.explain: Financial subject areas are organized per product area (GL, Payables, Receivables, Assets, Cash Management, etc.), with access typically granted by product-specific duty roles.

questions.q: Why can OTBI show an invoice that was entered thirty seconds ago, while a Financial Reporting Studio report tied to a nightly-refreshed cube cannot?
options: OTBI queries live transactional data and application view objects directly, rather than a separately maintained, periodically refreshed cube
OTBI is simply a faster version of the same cube technology
Financial Reporting Studio does not support any form of real-time data
There is no actual difference between the two tools' data freshness
questions.explain: OTBI integrates with the application's own data in real time, while Financial Reporting Studio is bound by the refresh schedule of its underlying cube.
